# GitHub MCP Server Connector Test

This file was created on **November 15, 2026** to verify end-to-end write operations via the **GitHub MCP Server** connector:

1. Creating a feature branch (`test/github-mcp-connector-2026-11-15`) from `main`
2. Committing a new file via the GitHub API
3. Opening a pull request against `main`

> **Cleanup:** Once verified, you can safely close this pull request and delete the `test/github-mcp-connector-2026-11-15` branch without affecting production (`main`).
